chunks: Say: "Who guards you by night and by day from the Most Merciful?" Yet from the remembrance of their Lord they turn away.
ai.seo_question: Who is the true protector from Allah by night and day?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah’s exclusive guardianship (wilayah) over creation, contrasting the polytheists' superficial reliance on idols with their actual spiritual neglect. It serves as a critique of those who claim divine association yet remain heedless of the Remembrance (Dhikr) of their Lord, emphasizing that true protection stems from conscious submission to Ar-Rahman.
